label: Mid/late copy-phase steps (recall_idx >= 3), boosted around specific tokens (output z/j/o, previous input 1/x/n, next output z)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase and never in the original or delimiter phase. It is also never active on an input that is the first occurrence of its token. Nearly all activity has recall_idx >= 3 (98% of activations and 99% of mass); the rate peaks at recall_idx 4-5 (16-19%) and is highest near the end of the output (to_go 0-2). Within that window, which steps fire is strongly token-dependent: the rate is raised when the token being output is z, j, or o (lift 4.6-7.7x), when the previous input is 1, x, or n (3.3-4.7x), or when the next output is z (5.6x). The largest activations sit on steps just before or at a z/j output. The phase-and-position condition alone has precision of only about 0.11. The token disjunction raises dev F1 to 0.47 (mass recall 0.78), but the token dependence is diffuse and spread over many tokens, so this is a partial description.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: 1, x, n, q, f, y; least: k, d, <DEL>, b) and the token being output (most: z, j, o, c, e, b; least: u, x, d, -); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=4, L=3 & t=5, recall_idx=5.
